CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Teachings on Prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Teachings on Prayer.
   B. Use Teachings on Prayer to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Teachings on Prayer with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Teachings on Prayer has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Calming the Storm? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Calming the Storm.
   B. Apply the teaching of Calming the Storm with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Calming the Storm has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Calming the Storm to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

4. Which response best shows understanding of Teaching on Prayer 7 4.2 The Lost Sheep 7 5.0 The Church 5.1 The Holy Spirit 7 5? (1 mark)
   A. Use Teaching on Prayer 7 4.2 The Lost Sheep 7 5.0 The Church 5.1 The Holy Spirit 7 5 to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Teaching on Prayer 7 4.2 The Lost Sheep 7 5.0 The Church 5.1 The Holy Spirit 7 5 with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Teaching on Prayer 7 4.2 The Lost Sheep 7 5.0 The Church 5.1 The Holy Spirit 7 5 has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Teaching on Prayer 7 4.2 The Lost Sheep 7 5.0 The Church 5.1 The Holy Spirit 7 5.

5. Which response best shows understanding of The Holy Spirit? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Holy Spirit with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Holy Spirit.
   C. Say The Holy Spirit has no place in daily life.
   D. Use The Holy Spirit to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Faith and God’s Promises? (1 mark)
   A. Say Faith and God’s Promises has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Faith and God’s Promises.
   C. Use Faith and God’s Promises to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Faith and God’s Promises with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Which response best shows understanding of God’s Plan for Redemption? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing God’s Plan for Redemption.
   B. Apply the teaching of God’s Plan for Redemption with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use God’s Plan for Redemption to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say God’s Plan for Redemption has no place in daily life.

8. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Spreading rumours

9. Which response best shows understanding of Abrahamic Covenant? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Abrahamic Covenant with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Abrahamic Covenant has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Abrahamic Covenant.
   D. Use Abrahamic Covenant to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

11. Which response best shows understanding of The Holy Spirit 7 5.2 Acts of Compassion 7 Page 13 of 72 xiii 6.0 Christian Livi? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Holy Spirit 7 5.2 Acts of Compassion 7 Page 13 of 72 xiii 6.0 Christian Livi with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use The Holy Spirit 7 5.2 Acts of Compassion 7 Page 13 of 72 xiii 6.0 Christian Livi to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say The Holy Spirit 7 5.2 Acts of Compassion 7 Page 13 of 72 xiii 6.0 Christian Livi has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Holy Spirit 7 5.2 Acts of Compassion 7 Page 13 of 72 xiii 6.0 Christian Livi.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Healing of the Paralytic? (1 mark)
   A. Use Healing of the Paralytic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Healing of the Paralytic has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Healing of the Paralytic.
   D. Apply the teaching of Healing of the Paralytic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Acts of Compassion and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
